moments.author: Bleacher Report
moments.quote: Thanasis Antetokounmpo is leaving the NBA and signing a three‑year deal with Greek club ARIS Thessaloniki.
moments.why: An unexpected NBA champion departing the league to play in Greece is catching everyone’s attention.

moments.author: Bleacher Report
moments.quote: Tacko Fall has signed with the 76ers—back in the NBA for the first time since 2022.
moments.why: A beloved fan‑favorite center makes a surprising NBA return after years away.

moments.author: Bleacher Report
moments.quote: Odell Beckham Jr. is switching his number back to No. 13 for the Giants.
moments.why: OBJ’s nostalgic change back to #13 resonates with longtime Giants and football fans.

moments.author: Jon Rothstein
moments.quote: Michigan’s Brandon McCoy will miss the 2026‑27 season with a torn ACL.
moments.why: A key college basketball player sidelined for the year is huge news for fans and bracket watchers.

moments.author: The New York Times / quoting Colin Kaepernick
moments.quote: Kaepernick no longer watches pro football, calling the league’s moves to address racism “so performative.”
moments.why: Kaepernick’s sharp critique of the NFL’s social justice efforts reignites cultural and sports debates.
